THE BIGGEST MISTAKE IN ORDER BLOCK TRADING?

Marking every opposite-coloured candle as an Order Block.

My quality checklist:
✅ Strong displacement away from the zone.
✅ Clear BOS or MSS.
✅ FVG formation adds confluence.
✅ Fresh and unmitigated zone.
✅ Alignment with higher-timeframe bias.

If price closes through the zone in the wrong direction, I stop treating it as a valid OB.
Quality over quantity.

As an ICT Trader  we don’t trade Mondays, we wait for Monday range to form. 

Then we skip Tuesdays as we wait for the break of Monday range High or Low 

Wednesdays a red news event so no trade.

Thursday waiting for confirmation after news event, no trade.

Friday - too close to weekend no trade day.

Saturday we review the week 

Sunday we plan for the Next Week
